gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
The team was let ___ by its own supporters.
gaps.explanation: let somebody down = disappoint them by failing to help.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.
